signature.name: VTask.hrecOn'
signature.type: {α : Sort u_1} -> {s₁ : Setoid α} -> {φ : Quotient s₁ → Sort u_5} -> (qa : Quotient s₁) -> (f : (a : α) → φ (Quotient.mk'' a)) -> (c : ∀ (a₁ a₂ : α), a₁ ≈ a₂ → f a₁ ≍ f a₂) -> φ qa

conventions.statement: When qa = Quotient.mk'' x for a concrete representative x, VTask.hrecOn' qa f c computes definitionally to f x.
conventions.note: This is the standard beta-reduction rule for quotient recursors.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Sort*} {s₁ : Setoid α} {φ : Quotient s₁ → Sort*} (f : ∀ a, φ (Quotient.mk'' a)) (c : ∀ a₁ a₂, a₁ ≈ a₂ → f a₁ ≍ f a₂) (a₁ a₂ : α), a₁ ≈ a₂ → HEq (VTask.hrecOn' (Quotient.mk'' a₁) f c) (VTask.hrecOn' (Quotient.mk'' a₂) f c)
